summary: Fresenius Medical Care AG filed a routine Form 6-K for the period ended 2026-09-30, containing Q3 2026 interim financial statements, segment disclosures, and share buyback program tranche data (tranches dated 2025-08-11 through 2026-08-31). No transaction, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed. The filing is an ordinary periodic foreign-private-issuer report mapped to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q equivalent; the referenced buyback tranches are recurring capital-return activity rather than a special situation. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
